ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens: loose leaves in light green, dark green and burgundy-tinged red-purple, some crisp and ruffled, spread across most of the bowl's inner surface, flat with little height (about 1-2 cm piled), slightly moist with no dressing sheen | 60
ITEM 2 | Two pale white cheese pieces, roughly 3-4 cm square and 1-1.5 cm thick, with golden-brown seared/charred edges and dark flecks on top, firm and holding shape, matte surface, resting on the greens at the upper left and right | 45
ITEM 3 | Heap of diced yellow corn kernels mixed with small pale grains or chopped bits and a few green herb flecks, moist and slightly glossy, loosely piled in the centre-left of the bowl about 6 x 5 cm and 2 cm high, with some scattered crumbs | 55
ITEM 4 | Small scattered crumbs and bits of pale white cheese or grain, a few near the salad edge, crumbly and dry-looking, under 1 cm each | 5
